entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Ramesh Kumar, Adv.
For the State : Mr. Sardhu Mahto, A.P.P.

1. The applicant who is in custody since 08.05.2023 has approached this Court for grant of regular
bail in connection with S.T. No.436 of 2023 arising out of Chainpur P.S. Case No.171 of 2022,
corresponding to G.R. Case No.1050 of 2023, registered for the offence under Sections 306/ 498A,
504/34 of Ipc, pending in the court of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-V, Palamau at Daltonganj.

entities.text: Addl. Sessions Judge-V, Palamau at Daltonganj
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of F.I.R. alongwith
its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her
part.
3.  Innocence has been claimed and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the deceased was the second wife and there was a family dispute as there was two wives in the house.
She has committed suicide by consuming pesticide.
Charge has already been framed but till date not a single witness has been examined.
On above basis prayer for bail has been made.
4. Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant.
5. Considering the materials available on record, I am inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.

Accordingly, the applicant, named above, is directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bonds of Rs.10,000/- (Ten thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Addl. Sessions Judge-V, Palamau at Daltonganj in connection with S.T. No.436 of 2023 arising out of Chainpur P.S. Case No.171 of 2022, corresponding to G.R. Case No.1050 of 2023,
subject to condition that the applicant will submit self-attested copy of his Aadhaar Card and also Munna Singh @ Munna Kumar Singh vs The State Of Jharkhand ....
